facts.text: I am hiring a graphic designer through Fiverr to create a logo for a new brand.
I am providing feedback on the work the designer has done so far.
I am not happy with the results of the logo design work so far.
I want to transmit my feedback without being too harsh.
I did not like the revisions the designer provided.
I want to write a message telling the designer I do not want to continue with the process.
The designer offered a refund but asked to be given another chance to revise the design.
I want to decline politely after the designer’s message.
I want to mention that I would not like the designer to lose more time.
I want to mention that I am not the only one involved in the approval process.
I will hire another designer through Fiverr.
Vital Wear is a brand of scrubs for medical doctors and students.

events.text: User decides to decline continuing with the logo process and asks for help writing a message to the designer.
Designer responds offering a refund and requesting another chance to revise the design.
User asks to include that the designer should not lose more time and that multiple people are involved in approval.
User decides to hire another Fiverr designer and asks how the new design brief should look.
User provides brand details for Vital Wear and asks for brand attributes.
